report: Lineup is set, so there are no start/sit changes. Rhamondre Stevenson is questionable. He is a good flex against Detroit (DET is 30th vs RBs), so keep him in unless he is ruled out, and Woody Marks is the backup. At 2-7 the season depends on quarterback and the flex spots. The best trade to send is Kirk Cousins from gavinzteam. He has three QBs, and Cousins averages 19.14 with a 13.77 floor against Stafford's 9.12 floor. After that, send Christian Watson and Brock Bowers, which are the biggest upgrades on the board.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford averages 15.87 and is trending down (12.33 over his last 3). His 9.12 floor is a weak spot.
Javonte Williams is a true RB1 at 17.73 on 23 carries per game. Rachaad White at 9.74 and Stevenson at 12.63 are mediocre.
Tee Higgins is at 19.98 (28.17 over his last 3) and McMillan is at 15.56. Jameson Williams is steady at 13.21.
LaPorta averages 11.64 but has fallen to 5.5 over his last 3.
Flournoy (9.31) and Marks (8.86, floor 8.28) are safe but low-scoring flex options.
McGowan, Knight, Black and Strong are all under 6 points per game and cannot start. Only Marks and Flournoy are useful.

plan: Upgrade the WR/flex spot with Christian Watson (+6.5 per game).
Upgrade TE with Brock Bowers (+9.2 per game) or RB with Chuba Hubbard.

replacements.why: Short-term questionable tag; Marks has 17 carries per game and an 8.28 floor.

drops.why: Third-string ARI back with no stats and nothing to start him over.

trades.why: Cousins is the target: he averages 19.14 (20.41 over his last 3) with a 13.77 floor, against Stafford's 15.87 average and 9.12 floor. This is MORE RELIABLE and MORE POINTS. gavinzteam holds Burrow plus Cousins and Shough, so he has a spare QB. His RBs average 6.3 and 11.4, and Marks gives him 17 carries per game of depth.
trades.fallback: Add Black; walk away if he wants a starter
